name: Post-Impressionism
intro: After Impressionism, painters in France took its bright colour somewhere new: toward solid structure, strong feeling, flat colour and pattern. Each picture here shows one thing to look for.
homeDescription: How to recognize Post-Impressionism, from Seurat and Cézanne to Van Gogh, Gauguin, Toulouse-Lautrec and Rousseau, in a short illustrated guide.
ldDescription: A short guide to recognizing Post-Impressionism in France, about 1884 to 1906, compiled from museum collection records.
sourcesDescription: Lectures, curricula, museum collection records and reference sources used to compile {name}.
